DocNotFound: There is no doc at '<Path>'. ListDocs shows what is there.
DocTooLarge: '<Path>' is over 1 MB; a doc that size is not read whole. Search it instead.
FolderNotFound: There is no folder '<Path>' in the docs. ListDocs with no folder shows the top.
NoMatches: Nothing in the docs contains '<Query>'. Try another word, or ListDocs to see what is there.
NotADoc: '<Path>' is not a doc: only .md and .txt files are read here.
OutsideTheDocs: '<Path>' is outside the docs: only a path under the docs root, with no '..', can be read.
QueryEmpty: SearchDocs needs some text to look for.
